notes: Deploy MarginaliaPages from src/MarginaliaPages.sol on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1). Constructor (address hook, address intake, bytes32 action, address signer): the live MarginaliaHook of launch 1283 (0xf0457dd0cf526686190e4f057ba19db14d34a0cc), the IdentityMD Intake (0x1397434cd35e8a9C8aC312A61D3A285EB31dea56), bytes32('oracle.request@oracle-1') UTF-8 right-padded with zeros, and the IdentityMD oracle signer (0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982): the same INTAKE, ACTION and ORACLE_SIGNER constants the live hook holds. The constructor reads no chain state; it rejects zero values and stores the four. Pages are non-transferable seats that trade only on an uncapped linear curve priced in IMD (0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7): the n-th page costs BASE 0.1 IMD x n, and the reserve always covers every holder selling out. Every trade pays FEE_BPS 10% of its value: ISSUER_BPS 90% of the fee to the issuer in IMD (or into the handle's escrow), BURN_BPS 5% of the fee queues permissionless bounded MARG purchases on the launch pool through the hook's PoolManager via burnPending (a quiet buy with no hook fee, bounded by an on-chain per-block sqrt-price limit of 0.5%) and sends the MARG to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, and the remaining 5% of the fee goes to the hook's pools through hook.fundPot (70% thesis prize / 30% writer refund). An issuer is any address (subjectOf) or an unclaimed X handle (subjectOfHandle, lower-cased and validated on chain: 1-15 of a-z, 0-9, underscore). Handle claims are oracle-attested: requestClaim(handle, tweetId) pays the Intake's current price for the action (refused above MAX_PRICE 1 IMD), builds the syndication question on chain (answerType address, evidence panel, head 1, PANEL_SIZE 5, QUORUM 4) and buys one answer with callback onOracleResult, which accepts only the Intake, verifies the EIP-712 attestation (IdentityMD Oracle v2) against the signer, requires chainId == block.chainid, agreed >= quorum >= 4 and panelSize >= 5, and consumes each request id once. A real address becomes the payee and settleClaim releases the escrow less the oracle price reimbursed to the asker when the escrow covers it; the zero address is a failed claim, retriable at once. One request in flight per subject, abandonable by anyone after ANSWER_DEADLINE 3 days; one successful claim per subject ever. Escrow unclaimed CLAIM_WINDOW 90 days after the first buy may be recycled into the hook's pools by anyone, never while a claim is pending. No owner, pause, upgrade or attester; trades, claims and the callback are nonReentrant; unlockCallback accepts only the PoolManager.
